protocol.point_selection: one fixed registry; choose T/RH/wind marginal point models separately by pooled available-hour validation MAE; decision scenario model chosen by balanced loss; no changes after either evaluation year
protocol.wind_units: Meteostat wspd km/h divided by 3.6; GFS 10m vector speed m/s; station sensor height not independently confirmed
protocol.analog_policy: equal group mean squared standardized forecast distance; scaler trained only on prior seasons; joint complete-night T/RH/wind residual paths transported onto current GFS; RH clipped 0..100, wind clipped >=0
protocol.event_schedule_policy: analog event = cold member fraction >=0.25; select one whole conditional cold/warm path minimizing average absolute duration/14 + first-sample/14 + cold-dose/28 + mask disagreement/14; point T/RH/wind are marginal medians and distinct from warning path
protocol.missing_policy: fit scalar heads per available target; analog library requires complete T/RH/wind; score each target on available pairs; night aggregates require full relevant target; no imputation
protocol.new_targets: wind speed, cold degree-hours below 0, high-RH hourly bins >=90%, low-wind hourly bins <2m/s, cold-and-high-RH joint bins; meteorological proxies, not tissue damage, leaf wetness, disease or yield
protocol.uncertainty: empirical analog member frequencies and 10..90 percentile intervals; evaluate CRPS/Brier/coverage/reliability counts; no guaranteed coverage or calibrated crop probabilities
protocol.status: fixed before validation; 2025 already viewed historical control, excluded from fitting/selection; attempt unseen completed spring 2026 only after choice frozen
protocol.deployment: research only; keep field GFS and existing demonstrations unchanged
